accepted_counterexamples.verdict: Failure冠盛股份 is markedly more resilient against shock E=2023-12-18 than winner长白山, but broke immediately after first board.
Nearly identical shock response yields entirely divergent continuation heights; resilience alone does not discriminate.

accepted_counterexamples.cross_year_instability: In matched-date comparisons, winner return was higher in 46/73 days in 2024, but only 29/62 days in 2025; winner drawdown was shallower in only 5/17 days in 2026; 2026 same-day rank was 8 days higher, 8 days lower, 1 day equal.

counterexamples_and_monotonicity_rejecti.formal_rejection: Formally reject any rule that monotonically awards score or probability to simple resilience, lower drawdown, or bounce intensity.

operator_definition_corrections.E_definition: E is the MOST RECENT confirmed lower-limit close of a prior-day >=5 stock in S-10..S-1, not the first shock.
operator_definition_corrections.D_drawdown_definition: D is the lowest price drop relative to E-1 close (min Low / P_{E-1} - 1), not a standard rolling peak-to-trough maximum drawdown.
operator_definition_corrections.unknown_accounting: 387 is the count of individual candidate rows with immature/missing 5-day paths (1.36% of 28,503 rows), not 387 dates. In the allowed pool, known >=5 dates are 226/668, with an upper bound of 283 dates if all unknown rows are assumed winners.

low_space_and_ranking_treatment.low_space_regime: Retain theoretical boundary of space depression (H_space >= 3 breakdown) for future study; no fallback logic or new training arms added now; 4,692 no-shock candidates are strictly preserved in pool and not penalized or dropped.
low_space_and_ranking_treatment.cohort_ranking_bounds: Accept Codex recommendation: for dates with incomplete candidate data, compute ranking lower/upper bounds under full N denominator; strictly forbid presenting sub-cohort observed ranks as full-cohort ranks.

position_on_next_research_direction.topic: Post-pressure first repair timing and peer theme diffusion recognition (压力后谁先修复、有没有同线扩散认可)
position_on_next_research_direction.substantive_rationale: Resilience in isolation is often cold, illiquid inertia. A genuine leader candidate requires active structural differentiation: repairing prior to peers in time (earliest relative breakout from shock bottom) combined with positive feedback from same-theme cohort diffusion (peer follow-through / sub-relay bid support).
position_on_next_research_direction.strict_boundaries: Theme grouping and follow-through diffusion must be established strictly from historical data observable as of S closing; no post-hoc winner narrative labeling; theme data gaps must be documented separately; full candidate pools and failed peers preserved.
